label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Korda US Women's Open Surge
items.text: World No. 1 Nelly Korda shot a four-under 67 Friday to move within two strokes of the lead at the US Women's Open.

items.headline: Scheffler Battles at Memorial
items.text: Despite feeling like he might shoot 90, Scottie Scheffler scrambled to an even-par 72 and sits nine shots behind the Memorial leader.

items.headline: Fowler’s Sinus Infection Hurts Play
items.text: Rickie Fowler revealed he’s battled a sinus infection for weeks, which contributed to a 79 including four double bogeys at the Memorial.
